approvalSummary: Admin alone manages launch; owner accounts and analytics are deferred. Permanent Card URLs render eligible Business pages directly, alongside independent slugs and reserved aliases. Transfer requires deactivation; activation may precede Business enablement. Minimal successful Card history lasts for the Card lifetime. Name and unique slug suffice for explicit Business enablement. Accepted cardinalities, contacts, hours and external-only payments remain binding. Next.js/Supabase on Workers uses separate environments, expected versions, atomic audit/history, fresh fail-closed gates and revision-keyed caching. Operator steps and authoritative-read dependence buy controlled publication and revocation. Adapter/runtime compatibility, numerical operating targets and provider-native log/backup/restore review remain mandatory gates. Token/sample, schema, normalization, storage and detailed API/retry contracts remain unfinished. All four peer checks are incomplete; Architecture changed hash after the bounded content read. Root must record final checks before freezing approval hashes. Approval must name only the exact replacement of 'Status: Draft. Documentation only; no implementation is authorized.' with 'Status: Approved. Documentation only; no implementation is authorized.' No material postapproval rewrite or implementation is authorized.
